page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c4g1.xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 15.0 GB of system memory. The hardware configuration is distinguished by an integrated NVIDIA T4 GPU based on the Turing architecture, which provides 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. The instance does not include local storage and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance bifurcation. The host CPU and system memory exhibit weak to poor performance, with stress-ng, Geekbench, and Passmark scores consistently falling into the bottom 10% to 25% of tested servers. Memory read and write bandwidths are similarly constrained. Conversely, the onboard NVIDIA T4 GPU delivers strong performance for specialized workloads. LLM inference benchmarks for both small (135M) and medium (7B) models show top-tier prompt processing speeds and strong text generation throughput.

This instance offers a cost-efficient entry point for GPU-accelerated computing, balancing the expense of dedicated hardware accelerators by utilizing a lower-tier CPU and memory profile. It is highly suited for small to medium LLM inference, lightweight machine learning model deployment, and basic GPU-driven workloads. It is less appropriate for general-purpose compute, high-throughput database operations, or applications requiring high local storage IOPS.
